title: Port Lua 5.4 (C) to Rust, judged by the official Lua test suite
prompt: Port Lua 5.4 to Rust with the same behaviour, to the same pass list on the official Lua test suite as the C build.

judge.language: Lua scripts run by the interpreter under test
judge.command: the port's lua binary runs all.lua in the test directory (in a job); plus a differential corpus: each script's stdout from the C build vs the port
judge.cases: about 30 test files, thousands of assertions; the differential corpus is ours

source.why: A dress rehearsal for the Bun-shaped run at a quarter of the size: the same queue and sharding patterns, an afternoon on our hosts.
needs: Phase 2, our job hosts for cargo builds and the test run
Phase 3, repositories for one branch with many editors
